column1: # Supplementary Data 6 (Table S11). Reliability flag for every core-tier gene (16,885 rows; Ensembl 102 TSL1 protein-coding genes).

# unique_frac = u_g, the share of the gene's candidate windows (over all its annotated transcripts, free of annotated founder SNPs and small indels) that are gene-unique and single-copy in GRCm38 (Section 2.3). flag = u_g < 0.6; the threshold was chosen on Keele liver.

# 50bp columns use the design for 50 bp reads (probes spaced 26 nt); 100bp columns use the design for 100 and 101 bp reads (spaced 76 nt). frac_shared_50bp and frac_multicopy_50bp = shared and multi-copy shares of the gene's windows (50 bp design); n_emg_50bp = EM probes; ntx_50bp = annotated transcripts; gene_probes_50bp and gene_probes_101bp = gene probes at 50 and 101 bp; sv_risk_ge25 = 1 if the gene is in Table S12.
